title: Work tape flags in the configuration code
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $n,s$ be natural numbers, let $x$ be a Boolean string, let $c$ be a configuration of $M$ on input $x$, let $i$ index one of its work tapes, and let $j,b$ be natural numbers with $j<2s+1$ and $b<3$. The bit of the configuration code at the position assigned to work tape $i$, cell index $j$, and flag index $b$ (defaulting to false if out of range) equals the $b$-th bit of the three work flags for that tape and cell, with false as the default if the flag index is out of range.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine over Booleans
$c$ is a configuration of $M$ on input $x$
